text: Educational management is a discipline that integrates education and management. It focuses on the organization and operation of educational systems (schools, educational administrative departments, training institutions, etc.), resource allocation, quality improvement, and reform and development. The aim is to optimize the allocation of educational resources, improve educational efficiency, ensure educational equity, and ultimately promote the high-quality development of the education sector. From the class management in kindergartens to the strategic planning of universities, from the policy implementation of local education bureaus to the promotion of national education reforms, all of these fall within the scope of research and practice of educational management.
